blocks.text: I have always believed that Hollywood is a place built on myths, but every once in a while, reality delivers a plot twist so perfect it makes you believe in the magic of Tinseltown all over again. In an era when the entertainment industry often feels bogged down by joyless lectures, preachy themes, identity politics, woke agendas, and corporate box-checking, a piece of genuinely exciting, celebratory news has broken through the noise. Genealogical researchers have officially confirmed that Sydney Sweeney—the undisputed reigning queen of modern screen presence—is a distant biological relative of the legendary, immortal Marilyn Monroe.
